<translate>
'''Meteor Burst''' is a long strike combo that lasts about 6 seconds and mixes strikes, a slam and ki blasts. It is a rare reward of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]] world boss, and unlike most strike attacks it scales with both your Strike Damage (SKP) and your Ki Damage (PWR).
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it ==

No master teaches Meteor Burst by default. It has a '''15%''' chance to drop from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]] world boss (the server default; see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]]). Server owners can also add it to a master's list, where it costs '''24,000 TP''', and admins can grant it with {{Command|/dmztech add}}.

You need [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], an empty main hand and at least 5% Power Release, and the technique must be equipped in a technique slot.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works ==

Press the technique's slot key. As with every strike attack, you rush to the target in front of you (your lock-on target first, then the last enemy you hit, otherwise the one closest to your crosshair) within a 6-block cone, or 12 blocks while flying. Then the combo plays out over about '''6 seconds''', mixing strikes, a slam and ki blasts. Its damage multiplier is ×2.6, and it scales with both SKP and PWR.

Meteor Burst has the longest cooldown of any strike attack: '''30 seconds'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Upgrades ==

Like every strike attack, it gains experience when it hits, which you can spend on damage and cooldown (−2.5% per level, up to −50%). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Attacks|Strike Attacks]].
</translate>
